title: Rust: Markdown Parser
description: Build a parser that converts Markdown to HTML.

steps.title: Parse Headers
steps.description:
Write a function `parse_header(line: &str) -> Option` that converts `# Header` to `

Header

`, `## Header` to `

Header

`, etc. Test with levels 1 to 3.
hints: The number of `#` determines the heading level (1-6).
Strip the `#` and any following space, wrap in `<hN>` tags.

verification.failureMessage: Parse '# Title' and '## Section' and print HTML.

steps.title: Parse Bold and Italic
steps.description: Parse inline formatting: `**bold**` → `bold`, `*italic*` → `italic`. Replace within a line. Test with `"This is **bold** and *italic* text"`.
hints: Order matters: replace bold before italic (since bold uses two asterisks).

verification.failureMessage: Parse a line with bold and italic, print HTML.

steps.title: Parse Lists
steps.description: Parse unordered lists: lines starting with `-` or `*` become `<li>` inside `<ul>`. Consecutive list items are grouped. Test with a 3-item list.
hints: Track whether we're inside a list.
When a non-list line follows a list, close the `` tag.

verification.failureMessage: Parse a markdown list and print HTML.

steps.title: Parse Code Blocks
steps.description:
Parse fenced code blocks: text between ` ``` ` markers becomes `
...
`. Preserve whitespace. Test with a short code block.
hints: Lines inside code block are appended verbatim.

verification.failureMessage: Parse a fenced code block and print HTML.

steps.title: Full Markdown Renderer
steps.description: Combine all parsers into a full `markdown_to_html(md: &str) -> String` function. Test with a complete Markdown document containing headers, bold, lists, and code. Print the generated HTML.
hints: Apply each parser in order (list, header, code block, inline).

verification.failureMessage: Render a complete Markdown document to HTML and print.
